Definition: to deposit; by implication, to allow to stay
BiblicalUsage: Yânach means to leave something where it lies, to let it stay and not take it away. God suffered no man to do His anointed wrong, and Solomon left the temple vessels unweighed because they were too many to count.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God knows when to leave things alone, and what He leaves, He guards.
